source_refs.note: Book p. 184: 6.3.2 elements 1-6 (axis, vertex, chord/focal chord, focal distance, latus rectum, parametric equations) with Figure 6.12.

blocks.text: Har cheez ke hisson ke naam hote hain, jaise darakht ki jarr, tana aur shaakhen. Isi tarah parabola ke bhi kuch khaas hisse hain jin ke naam har sawal mein aate hain. Neeche kitab ke chhe elements hain; har ek ke baad hum dekhenge ke woh \(y^{2} = 4ax\) mein kahan hai.

Figure 6.12 ko saath saath dekhte rahiye. Har element ko figure mein ungli rakh kar dhoondiye: directrix baayen taraf khari line hai, vertex \(V\) origin par, focus \(F\) us se \(a\) units daayen, latus rectum focus se guzarti hui khari line jo \(L\) aur \(L'\) par curve se milti hai, focal chord focus se guzarne wala tircha chord, aur ek aam chord jo focus se nahi guzarta. Jab aap figure par yeh sab pehchan lenge to definitions khud yaad ho jayengi, ratne ki zaroorat nahi paregi.

items: Axis: Woh seedhi line jo focus se guzre aur directrix par perpendicular ho, parabola ka axis kehlati hai. Figure mein axis \(x\)-axis hai. Parabola is line ke gird symmetric hota hai, yaani is ke upar aur neeche ka hissa ek jaisa.

Vertex: Jis point par axis parabola se milta hai use vertex kehte hain. Figure mein \(V\) vertex hai jis ke coordinates \((0, 0)\) hain. Yeh parabola ka 'mor' hai, focus aur directrix ke bilkul darmiyan.
Chord and Focal Chord: Parabola ke do alag points ko milane wala line segment chord kehlata hai. Jo chord focus se guzre use focal chord kehte hain.
Focal Distance: Parabola ke kisi point ka focus se faasla us point ki focal distance kehlata hai. Figure mein \(|FP|\) focal distance hai.

Latus Rectum: Woh focal chord jo parabola ke axis par perpendicular ho, latus rectum kehlata hai. Is ki equation \(x = a\) hai. Yeh parabola \(y^{2} = 4ax\) ko un points par kaatta hai jahan \(y^{2} = 4a^{2}\), yaani \(y = \pm 2a\). Is liye latus rectum ke end points \(L(a, 2a)\) aur \(L'(a, -2a)\) hain.

blocks.alt: Pale yellow panel par cyan parabola y^2 = 4ax, magenta X aur Y axes. Baayen taraf cyan directrix x = -a (dono siron par teer) jis par Directrix likha hai. Vertex V(0, 0) aur focus F(a, 0) (Focus) teeron se dikhaye gaye. Latus rectum L(a, 2a) se L'(a, -2a) tak; P(at^2, 2at) (t-point) F se jura hai; ek focal chord F se guzarti hai aur ek aam chord bhi hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Latus rectum ke ends kaise nikle? Latus rectum ki line \(x = a\) hai. Is ko \(y^{2} = 4ax\) mein rakhein: \(y^{2} = 4a \cdot a = 4a^{2}\), yaani \(y = \pm 2a\). Is liye ends \(L(a, 2a)\) aur \(L'(a, -2a)\).
Do mufeed baatein (hamari taraf se, exercise mein kaam aayengi):
Latus rectum ki lambai: \(|LL'| = 2a - (-2a) = 4a\). Yaani \(y^{2} = 4ax\) mein \(x\) ke saath jo number hai, wohi latus rectum ki lambai hai.
Point \(P(x, y)\) ki focal distance: definition se \(|FP| = |PM| = x + a\). Misaal: \(L(a, 2a)\) ki focal distance \(a + a = 2a\).

items:
Parametric Equations: Equation \(y^{2} = 4ax\) ko parametric shakal mein bhi likh sakte hain. Maan lijiye \(\frac{y}{2a} = t\) aur \(\frac{2x}{y} = t\). To \(y = 2at\) aur \(2x = yt = (2at)t = 2at^{2}\), is liye \(x = at^{2}\). Yaani parametric equations yeh hain:
\[x = at^{2},\ y = 2at\]
Point \((at^{2}, 2at)\) har real \(t\) ke liye parabola par hota hai aur ise aksar \(t\)-point kaha jata hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Parameter (ek madadgaar variable jis se \(x\) aur \(y\) dono bante hain) ka faida kya hai? Do coordinates jo ek equation se bandhe hon, un ki jagah sirf ek letter \(t\) se poora point bata dete hain. Jaise ghar ka poora address likhne ki jagah sirf 'house number 7' keh dena.
Tasdeeq ke \(t\)-point curve par hai: \(x = at^{2}\), \(y = 2at\) ko \(y^{2} = 4ax\) mein rakhein:
\[(2at)^{2} = 4a^{2}t^{2}\]
\[4a(at^{2}) = 4a^{2}t^{2}\]
Dono taraf barabar, har \(t\) ke liye. \(t = 0\) se vertex, \(t = 1\) se \(L(a, 2a)\), \(t = -1\) se \(L'(a, -2a)\). Positive \(t\) upar wala aadha hissa deta hai aur negative \(t\) neeche wala. Exercise 6.3 ke Q8 mein isi \(t\)-point par tangent aur normal nikalenge.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Parabola \(y^{2} = 8x\) ke liye \(a\) kya hai, aur \(t = 2\) wala point kaun sa hai? (\(4a = 8\) se \(a = 2\); point \((at^{2}, 2at) = (8, 8)\). Check: \(8^{2} = 64\) aur \(8 \times 8 = 64\).) Is point ki focal distance \(x + a = 8 + 2 = 10\) hai.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: \(y^{2} = 4ax\) ke chaar numbers ek saath yaad karein: vertex \((0, 0)\), focus \((a, 0)\), directrix \(x = -a\), latus rectum \(x = a\) jis ki lambai \(4a\). Di gayi equation se \(a\) nikalne ke liye compare karein: \(y^{2} = 12x\) mein \(4a = 12\), yaani \(a = 3\).

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Parabola \(y^{2} = 20x\) ke elements nikalte hain. Compare karne se \(4a = 20\), yaani \(a = 5\).
Axis: \(y = 0\). Vertex: \((0, 0)\). Focus: \((5, 0)\). Directrix: \(x = -5\).
Latus rectum: \(x = 5\), ends \((5, 10)\) aur \((5, -10)\), lambai \(4a = 20\).
\(t\)-point: \((5t^{2}, 10t)\); misaal ke taur par \(t = 2\) se \((20, 20)\), aur check: \(20^{2} = 400 = 20 \times 20\).
Is point ki focal distance: \(x + a = 20 + 5 = 25\).

In sab elements ko ek kahani ki tarah yaad rakhein: axis parabola ki 'reedh ki haddi' hai jis ke gird woh symmetric hai; vertex woh jagah hai jahan curve mur kar wapas jata hai; focus andar chhupa hua khaas point hai; directrix bahar ki line; aur latus rectum focus par khari woh 'chaurai' hai jo batati hai ke parabola kitna khula hua hai. Jitna bara \(a\), utna chaura parabola.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Axis: focus se guzarne wali, directrix par perpendicular line (yahan \(y = 0\)).
2. Vertex: jahan axis curve se milta hai (yahan \((0, 0)\)).
3. Chord: curve ke do points ko milata hai; focal chord: focus se guzarne wala chord.
4. \(P\) ki focal distance: \(|FP|\); \(y^{2} = 4ax\) ke liye yeh \(x + a\) hai.
5. Latus rectum: axis par perpendicular focal chord; \(x = a\), ends \((a, \pm 2a)\), lambai \(4a\).
6. Parametric form: \(x = at^{2}\), \(y = 2at\); \((at^{2}, 2at)\) ko \(t\)-point kehte hain.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Latus rectum ki lambai \(2a\) likh dena (yeh sirf \(L\) se \(F\) tak aadha hissa hai).
2. \(t\)-point ko \((2at, at^{2})\) likhna: \(y^{2} = 4ax\) mein \(t^{2}\) wala hissa \(x\) ke saath jata hai.
3. Vertex se guzarne wale har chord ko focal chord kehna. Focal chord ko focus se guzarna zaroori hai.
